finding: A keyless tools/call of microsoft_docs_search with arguments {} answered HTTP 200 on 2026-09-30 with content text {"results":[]} and a matching structuredContent, carrying neither isError nor an error member. The call is declared legal by that tool's own schema, which has no required array and gives query a "default": null, while its sibling microsoft_code_sample_search requires the same field. So a client that drops or misnames query is told, in the shape of a success, that Microsoft's documentation contains nothing for it. The control is a separate record in the same pass: an unknown TOOL name on this endpoint answers a proper JSON-RPC -32602, so the error channel works and is simply not reached for arguments. A client branching on isError or on error cannot distinguish this refusal from an empty result set.
